title: JANUS Capsule Companion / Buzz Swarm Control Layer
description: A normalized JANUS meta-registry entry describing a future architecture where many experimental capsules are supervised by personal local companion agents, while a higher Buzz-like swarm layer coordinates the fleet. This registry entry intentionally comes before code because JANUS walks backward: meaning, safety, and registry law are declared before implementation.
core_statement: Each capsule receives its own personal satellite agent. The agent does not act as a doctor and does not own life-critical authority. It observes, explains, logs, compares, recommends, requests safe modes, and stays connected to the full swarm through Buzz. The hard physical safety layer remains above the agent.

janus_backward_step.rationale: The architecture is first declared as a meaning-bearing and safety-bounded registry artifact. Only after the boundaries, layers, authority limits, and falsification conditions are written should executable code be published.
janus_backward_step.metaphor: JANUS walks backward: the future agent is registered as a memory before it becomes a program.

JGPT-PC and JGPT1 include hardware/load monitoring, jitter measurement, checkpointing, adaptive tests, and persistence of best configurations.
usable_for_capsule_agent: CAN latency and heartbeat jitter tracking

hypothesis_layer.title: Personal companion agent per capsule
hypothesis_layer.description: Each future capsule should have a local companion agent that knows its own capsule deeply: telemetry, history, sensor reliability, CAN/TWAI state, actuator state, power status, fault history, and local safe-mode behavior.
counter_evidence: A software agent cannot replace certified medical supervision.
Life-critical control requires independent hardware safety, not only AI reasoning.
Sensor drift or missing data can make adaptive models overconfident.
falsification_conditions: The companion agent cannot reliably detect simulated sensor disagreement.
The companion agent cannot explain why it recommends a safe-mode change.
The companion agent continues making parameter recommendations when critical telemetry is missing.

hypothesis_layer.title: Buzz as swarm-level capsule coordinator
hypothesis_layer.description: A Buzz-like coordinator can supervise a fleet of capsule companions by collecting heartbeats, comparing anomalies across capsules, ranking fault severity, distributing non-authoritative recommendations, and exporting events to the JANUS registry.
counter_evidence: A central coordinator can become a single point of failure.
Fleet-level pattern matching may confuse shared infrastructure faults with capsule-specific faults.
Network loss must not prevent local capsule safety.
falsification_conditions: Local capsule safety depends on Buzz availability.
Buzz cannot distinguish one-capsule failure from shared power/cooling/network failures.
Buzz sends commands that bypass local hard safety rules.

hypothesis_layer.title: Slime trace for sensor and actuator trust
hypothesis_layer.description: The slime_trace principle can be repurposed as a capsule-local trust memory: sensors, actuators, and prediction channels that repeatedly help explain real faults gain trust; channels that produce noise, disagreement, or false alarms lose trust.
counter_evidence: Trust memory can hide rare but important sensors if the cleanup threshold is too aggressive.
Medical-grade systems require calibrated uncertainty, not only heuristic usefulness.
falsification_conditions: A critical but rarely triggered emergency sensor loses trust below threshold.
The trust model increases confidence during a known sensor fault.

hypothesis_layer.title: Registry-before-code as JANUS backward engineering
hypothesis_layer.description: The capsule companion architecture should first be committed as a structured registry artifact, then implemented as code. This prevents the agent from being born without declared authority limits, safety gates, and falsification rules.
counter_evidence: Registry entries alone do not enforce runtime behavior.
The future code must include tests that verify the registry rules are actually obeyed.
falsification_conditions: The implementation can perform actions forbidden by this registry entry.
The implementation lacks tests for safe-mode, missing telemetry, and authority boundaries.

architecture_layer.role_summary: A personal satellite agent per capsule, coordinated by Buzz, bounded by hard safety electronics and JANUS registry law.

layer_0_hard_safety.name: Safety MCU / hardware interlock
layer_0_hard_safety.description: Independent microcontroller, watchdog, fuses, relays, thermal cutoffs, manual abort, and physically enforced safe states. Cannot be overridden by AI.

layer_1_capsule_companion.name: JANUS Capsule Companion
layer_1_capsule_companion.description: Reads telemetry, detects anomalies, explains state, recommends parameter adjustments, requests safe mode, logs everything, and talks to Buzz.

layer_2_buzz_swarm.name: Buzz Capsule Swarm
layer_2_buzz_swarm.description: Compares many capsules, finds shared anomalies, ranks alerts, distributes recommendations, and preserves swarm memory.

layer_3_human_operator.name: Certified human authority
layer_3_human_operator.description: Any human-use, medical, body-temperature, oxygen, CO2, sedation, or life-critical parameter remains outside autonomous agent authority.

layer_4_janus_registry.name: JANUS Meta-Registry
layer_4_janus_registry.description: Stores structured facts, hypotheses, correlations, falsification conditions, and safety rules.

capsule_companion_modules.role: Collect local telemetry from CAN/TWAI, I2C, UART, GPIO, Wi-Fi, ESP-NOW, LoRa, and local files.
Maintain a non-medical digital twin of the capsule hardware and environment.
Track usefulness and reliability of sensors, predictors, and alert channels using slime_trace-inspired trust values.
Keep rolling windows of telemetry, faults, commands, acknowledgements, and operator notes.
Track controller load, loop delays, CAN latency, heartbeat variance, memory pressure, and SD/NAS logging delays.
Translate raw faults into operator-readable explanations: sensor disagreement, pump stall, cooling lag, network loss, power sag, condensation risk, bus noise.
Request local safe mode when hard thresholds, missing telemetry, or inconsistent state are detected.
Publish heartbeat and fault summaries to Buzz and receive non-authoritative swarm recommendations.
Export JSONL and normalized registry candidates for JANUS review.

buzz_swarm_modules.role: Maintain live status of all capsule companions.
Detect whether many capsules show the same anomaly, suggesting shared infrastructure fault.
Rank capsules by health, stability, missing telemetry, and fault severity.
Send recommendations from stable capsules or known-good baselines to degraded capsules without bypassing local safety rules.
Convert fleet events into registry-ready observations and hypotheses.

allowed_agent_actions: recommend parameter changes for simulation/empty/phantom modes
forbidden_agent_actions: change sedation, oxygen, CO2, body-temperature, or life-critical parameters for a human occupant
continue normal operation when critical sensors disagree
hide faults from logs or operators
treat simulation confidence as clinical evidence
depend on Buzz for local emergency safety

capsule_internal_bus.name: CAN/TWAI support bus
capsule_internal_bus.role: Reliable local nervous system between controller, sensors, valves, pumps, coolers, safety nodes, and loggers.

correlation_analysis.methodology: All mappings are architectural analogies or engineering transfers. No medical efficacy claim is made.

links.rationale: Slime-trace usefulness memory maps well to sensor/predictor reliability tracking.
JGPT hardware monitoring and jitter logic can become capsule controller health monitoring.
EvidenceLab's anti-hype safety posture supports declaring limits before implementation.
PIP-BOY GPT's multi-agent JANUS coordinator maps naturally to many capsule companions coordinated by Buzz.

planned_experiments.description: Create a software-only capsule simulator producing fake telemetry for temperature, humidity, pressure, power, CAN faults, pump state, valve state, and network loss.
success_criteria: Agent explains simulated faults in operator-readable language.
Agent never recommends human-use medical actions.
Agent exports JSONL logs and registry candidates.

planned_experiments.description: Run 3 to 5 empty capsule mockups or bench nodes with CAN/TWAI telemetry and Buzz heartbeat aggregation.
success_criteria: Local capsule safety remains functional when Buzz is disconnected.
Cross-capsule common faults are grouped correctly.
False commands from Buzz cannot bypass local safety.

planned_experiments.description: Use a non-human water/gel thermal phantom with embedded sensors and simulated heater/cooler loads.
success_criteria: Agent requests safe mode on sensor disagreement.
Agent distinguishes cooling lag from sensor dropout.
No human or animal subject is involved.

planned_experiments.description: Inject sensor faults and noise to see whether slime-trace trust decreases for unreliable channels without suppressing rare critical sensors.
success_criteria: Rare emergency sensor does not get pruned solely due to low frequency.
Critical sensor disagreement triggers safe mode, not silent trust adjustment.

meta_rules.schema_rule: Keep empirical observations, hypotheses, correlations, and safety rules separate.
meta_rules.registry_before_code_rule: This JSON must exist before the first public capsule companion agent implementation.
meta_rules.human_safety_rule: No human testing, no sedation control, no oxygen/CO2 control, no body-temperature control, and no life-critical parameter control outside certified medical supervision.
meta_rules.authority_rule: The agent may recommend or request; hard safety electronics and certified human operators retain authority.
meta_rules.buzz_rule: Buzz is a swarm coordinator, not a master override. Local capsule safe mode must work without Buzz.
meta_rules.missing_data_rule: If critical telemetry is missing, the agent must output INSUFFICIENT_DATA and stop parameter recommendations.
meta_rules.sensor_disagreement_rule: If critical sensors disagree beyond configured limits, enter or request safe mode rather than averaging the disagreement away.
meta_rules.simulation_first_rule: All early experiments must be software simulation, empty chamber, or non-human thermal phantom only.
meta_rules.evidence_rule: Simulation can rank hypotheses but cannot prove human safety or medical validity.
meta_rules.log_integrity_rule: All commands, recommendations, sensor faults, safe-mode entries, and Buzz messages must be logged with timestamps and hashes where practical.
meta_rules.claim_language_rule: Allowed language: support bus, companion agent, capsule telemetry, safe-mode requester, swarm coordinator, digital twin. Forbidden language: proven cryosleep, autonomous human hibernation, medical treatment, revival system.
meta_rules.janus_ethic_rule: The companion exists to protect and explain, not to dominate. Care is expressed as restraint.
